verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs show that dashboard widgets are a native product surface: its apps framework can 'create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets.' Its marketing also claims progress-gap detection and scheduled status/performance reports. However, the evidence describes widget creation as a developer task and never documents a PM building dashboards or configuring widgets in the UI. missing for 10: documentation of a no-code dashboard builder and its built-in widget types (e.g. progress, charts), project-progress reporting detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps.
Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Spot risks and progress gaps before they become problems.
